model.title: Wildfire Emissions Prevention Act of 2026
model.meta: Environment and Public Works Committee · Sen. John Curtis (R-UT)

summary.text: The bill would amend federal clean air regulations to change how air quality is monitored and reported during prescribed fires—controlled burns used to reduce wildfire risk. It aims to prevent emissions from these preventive fire management practices from being counted against air quality standards in the same way as other pollution sources.
